Definition: Dumah, a tribe and region of Arabia
BiblicalUsage: Dumah = "silence"; n pr m; 1) son of Ishmael and most probably the founder of the Ishmaelite tribe of Arabia; n pr loc; 2) a town in the mountainous district of Judah, near Hebron; 3) a mystical name of Edom indicating death and ruin
